records.subject: Haven't seen you in Wrenfield lately
records.body:
Hi Jules,

It looks like setup stalled before the first project. If it would help, I can set up your first project with you so there's less to figure out on your own.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Jules,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Six days since signup with no project, no invite, no tickets, and no reply to the welcome email [email:b4e2c30a]. Zero engagement signals and only 8 days left in the window, so unaided activation is unlikely though not impossible on a Starter self-serve account.

draft.subject: A hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Jules,

Following up on my note from last week. The quickest way to see what Wrenfield can do is to get a first project going -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Chidi
